title: DSN still points at sentry.io
msg: This DSN sends every event to Sentry SaaS, not GlitchTip. After cutover the Sentry bill keeps running and GlitchTip shows nothing.
fix: Replace it with the DSN from your GlitchTip project settings page (https://<key>@<your-glitchtip-host>/<project-id>).

title: Upload URL still points at sentry.io
msg: Source maps and debug files from this config still go to sentry.io, so GlitchTip stack traces stay minified.
fix: Set url to your GlitchTip host. glitchtip-cli reads .sentryclirc and SENTRY_URL, so the same file keeps working: glitchtip-cli sourcemaps upload ./dist --org <org> --project <project>.

title: Session Replay integration
msg: Session Replay sends replay_event and replay_recording items. GlitchTip ingest lists both as ignored item types: the replays are dropped and the SDK still records them in the browser.
fix: Remove the replay integration before switching the DSN. GlitchTip has no replay viewer.

title: Replay sample rate
msg: Replay sample rates only feed Session Replay. GlitchTip ingest ignores replay_event and replay_recording, so this rate buys CPU and upload bytes for nothing.
fix: Delete the replay sample rates (or set them to 0) together with the replay integration.

title: Profiling sample rate
msg: Profiling sends profile or profile_chunk items. GlitchTip ingest ignores both, so no profile ever appears.
fix: Remove the profiling rate. For slow endpoints use GlitchTip Performance, which reads transactions and their spans.

title: Profiling integration or package
msg: The profiling integration samples the call stack and uploads profile items that GlitchTip ingest ignores.
fix: Remove the integration and the @sentry/profiling-node dependency; keep tracesSampleRate for GlitchTip Performance.

title: Cron monitor check-in
msg: Cron monitors send check_in items. GlitchTip ingest ignores check_in, so a scheduled job that stops running raises no alert.
fix: Create a GlitchTip uptime monitor of type Heartbeat and ping its URL when the job succeeds, or wrap the job: glitchtip-cli monitors run <ENDPOINT_UUID> -- <command>.

title: Release-health sessions on
msg: Session tracking sends session items. GlitchTip's own SDK pages set this option to false with the note 'GlitchTip does not support sessions'.
fix: Set autoSessionTracking: false (JS) or auto_session_tracking=False (Python), as in GlitchTip's SDK docs.

title: Manual session call
msg: Manual session calls produce session items that GlitchTip ingest ignores; crash-free rates will not exist after the move.
fix: Remove the call, or count sessions in your own analytics.

title: Event attachment
msg: Attachments travel as attachment items. GlitchTip ingest ignores them (it only parses a native minidump when no event came with it), so the file never reaches the issue.
fix: Put the small facts you need into setContext / set_context or tags; keep large files in your own storage and add their URL as context.

title: Sentry metrics API
msg: The metrics API sends trace_metric items. GlitchTip ingest ignores trace_metric, so the counter stays at zero.
fix: Send the value as a log line (enableLogs: true and Sentry.logger), which GlitchTip ingests, or move the metric to your metrics stack.

title: Standalone span streaming
msg: Standalone or streamed spans are sent as span items. GlitchTip ingest ignores span items; it reads spans only inside a transaction.
fix: Turn the experiment off so spans ship inside their transaction.

title: Every transaction sampled
msg: A 1.0 rate sends every transaction, and hosted GlitchTip counts each one as an event: Free is 1,000 events/mo, Small $15/mo is 100k. Past the quota GlitchTip throttles, and at 2x the quota it blocks fully, errors included.
fix: Use a low rate as GlitchTip's FAQ advises: tracesSampleRate: 0.01 (1 percent).

title: sentry-cli upload step
msg: sentry-cli uploads to https://sentry.io/ unless a url is set, so this CI step may still feed the old project.
fix: Set SENTRY_URL to your GlitchTip host for this step, or call glitchtip-cli sourcemaps inject / upload instead.

title: Self-hosted Sentry image (FSL)
msg: Self-hosted Sentry's web app is licensed FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0 (open.sentry.io/licensing): free to run for your business, but not as a commercial Sentry-like offering until each release turns Apache-2.0 after two years. GlitchTip is MIT.
fix: If you resell error tracking or host it for clients, run glitchtip/glitchtip (PostgreSQL 14+, one service, Valkey optional) instead.

title: Client reports on
msg: Client reports (counts of events the SDK discarded) are sent as client_report items, which GlitchTip ingest ignores.
fix: Set sendClientReports: false to save the request.
